population.proposed: One coupler family, fixed material stack, declared wavelength band and fabrication variations (#345). A proposed development design, not a ratified production population.

recommendation.basis: Exam design is deferred until the phase convention and coupled-power convergence are repaired: an exam built on an unresolved convention grades the convention (#345; RESULT section 9).

reference.applicability: Diagnostic only: coupled power is unconverged (about 15 % of the coupled fraction at 20 nm) and relative phase flips by about pi across resolutions.
reference.model: 3D FDTD of an asymmetric directional coupler

unresolved: Mode orientation, port reference planes, power normalization and complex phase convention are undefined (#345 task 1).
Coupled power does not converge at 40/30/20 nm; a 10-15 nm study or a mode-expansion reference is needed.
Radiated and absorbed energy are not accounted for, so no passivity tolerance is supportable.
Whether complex S-parameters are supportable is undecided; a power-only variant needs its own explicit contract.
The solver's licence and redistribution rights are not recorded.
